mapper.delete: DELETE FROM media_scan_song WHERE task_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM media_scan_task WHERE active_source IS NOT NULL)
DELETE FROM media_scan_directory WHERE task_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM media_scan_task WHERE active_source IS NOT NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_scan_task WHERE active_source IS NOT NULL
SELECT * FROM media_scan_task WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_scan_task (id, source_id, active_source, status, phase, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceId}, 'QUEUED', 'SCANNING', #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE media_scan_task SET status='RUNNING', started_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='QUEUED' AND cancel_requested=0
UPDATE media_scan_task SET cancel_requested=1 WHERE id=#{id} AND active_source IS NOT NULL AND phase='SCANNING'
UPDATE media_scan_task SET phase='COMMITTING' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND cancel_requested=0
UPDATE media_scan_task SET status=#{status}, error=#{error}, active_source=NULL, finished_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND active_source IS NOT NULL
UPDATE media_scan_task SET directories=#{directories}, entries=#{entries}, total_songs=#{total}, matched_songs=#{matched}, review_songs=#{review}, skipped_files=#{skipped} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_scan_directory (task_id, path_hash, path, depth) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{hash}, #{path}, #{depth})
mapper.select: SELECT path, path_hash, depth FROM media_scan_directory WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND processed=0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_scan_directory WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND path_hash=#{hash}
mapper.update: UPDATE media_scan_directory SET processed=1 WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND path_hash=#{hash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_scan_song (task_id, id, source_id, relative_path, path_hash, file_size, modified_at, scanned_at, parser_profile_id, parser_revision, selected_rule_id, result_json, needs_review) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{song.id}, #{song.sourceId}, #{song.relativePath}, #{song.pathHash}, #{song.fileSize}, #{song.modifiedAt}, #{song.scannedAt}, #{song.profileId}, #{song.revision}, #{song.ruleId}, #{song.resultJson}, #{song.needsReview})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM media_scan_song WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_song (id, source_id, relative_path, path_hash, file_size, modified_at, scanned_at, parser_profile_id, parser_revision, selected_rule_id, result_json, needs_review) SELECT id, source_id, relative_path, path_hash, file_size, modified_at, scanned_at, parser_profile_id, parser_revision, selected_rule_id, result_json, needs_review FROM media_scan_song WHERE task_id=#{taskId}
